vector_schema.description: Typed structure a Signal Quality v1 observation must conform to. Two independent implementations reading the same LIMIT at the same limit_created_bar must produce an identical object.

factor_observation_wrapper.name: FactorObservation<T>

value.rule: present and non-null iff status == AVAILABLE; null iff status == UNAVAILABLE. Never a numeric sentinel (never 0, never an average).

factor_observation_wrapper.canonical_semantics_decision: SINGLE source of truth per factor: the wrapper's status is DERIVED from each factor's own frozen contract, never a second independent judgment. For Alignment specifically, whose own frozen enum (BOT-047.2.3) already includes UNAVAILABLE as one of its 6 states, the wrapper's status is a deterministic 1:1 projection (status=UNAVAILABLE iff raw_state=="UNAVAILABLE"; status=AVAILABLE for the other 5 substantive states, value=raw_state). This gives every consumer a uniform status field to check without special-casing Alignment's enum, while the enum itself remains the untouched source of truth.

direction.role: metadata, never scored, never a 5th quality factor

direction_conditional_factors.alignment: AGAINST_CONFIRMED is the worst state historically for LONG (ExpR=-0.452) but near-best for SHORT (ExpR=+0.061) -- BOT-047.2.3
direction_conditional_factors.context: Friday effect significant in LONG/ALL, not significant in SHORT -- BOT-050.2
direction_conditional_factors.structure: significant U-shape at both extremes in LONG; not significant in SHORT -- BOT-048.2
direction_conditional_factors.momentum: effect asymmetric: Q1 (most-against) Exp$=-3.10 LONG vs -0.21 SHORT -- BOT-024.4 section 8. Formula itself is symmetric by construction.

momentum.semantic_definition: Short-horizon directional impulse (3 M5 bars / 15 minutes), ATR14-normalized, signed by trade direction, observed at limit_created_bar.
not_included_in_v1: rsi_delta_3 (CONTROL_ONLY, rho=+0.935 vs roc_atr_3 -- same phenomenon, not a second vote)
ema_slope_atr_5 (UNRESOLVED/MOMENTUM-SECONDARY -- distinct, not redundant, but unexplained pattern)

availability.unavailable_reason: warm-up: fewer than 3 preceding M5 bars, or ATR14 window incomplete (14-bar warm-up dominates the 3-bar lookback)
availability.observed_missing: 1/3207 (0.03%) Universe A (trade_id L00000, limit_created_bar=1); 0/2474 in Universe B (that single event never filled)

alignment.ordinality: explicitly rejected by the source contract -- not mapped to a numeric scale, not assumed benefit(ALIGNED_CONFIRMED) == -harm(AGAINST_CONFIRMED)
alignment.derivation: consensus of B0 (legacy 00:00 UTC boundary) and B1 (canonical 22:00 UTC boundary), each a HH/HL vs LH/LV sequence classification of the last 3 closed D1 blocks
alignment.special_semantics: NEUTRAL is a REAL OBSERVED VALUE (both B0 and B1 == NEUTRAL_MIXED, i.e. structure exists but shows no lean) -- distinct from UNAVAILABLE (either boundary lacks sufficient causal D1 history). This distinction is load-bearing: NEUTRAL must never be confused with or substituted for UNAVAILABLE.

availability.unavailable_reason: B0 UNAVAILABLE OR B1 UNAVAILABLE (priority rule -- consensus requires BOTH inputs computable)
availability.observed_missing: 18/2474 (0.73%), measured over Universe B (the only universe for which this artifact exists today)

structure.semantic_definition: Location of the entry relative to the HTF level whose breakout last armed the signal, normalized by ATR14. Measures LOCATION within recent structure, not external direction (Alignment) nor speed (Momentum).

context.note: Full 7-value enum preserved per the frozen contract even though Saturday is never observed in the historical dataset (market closed) -- not collapsed to a boolean is_friday.
context.direction_conditional: Friday effect significant in LONG/ALL, absent (not reversed) in SHORT -- BOT-050.2

availability.unavailable_reason: none expected -- time_utc always available, no warm-up documented

economics.schema_presence: ABSENT -- not a field, not null, not an UNAVAILABLE FactorObservation. Economics is not part of SignalQualityVectorV1 at all.

ownership_redirect.friction_spread_over_risk_breakeven_pct_: owned by CVP (strategy/scoring.py::cvp_score()), bit-exact match, outside Signal Quality entirely

economics.reopening_rule: requires a new ticket ID (e.g. BOT-049.4), never a silent reinterpretation of BOT-049.2

1_factor_inclusion.description: is this factor a field of the schema at all?

2_observation_availability.description: per-event AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE, only meaningful for included factors

availability_model.invariant: UNAVAILABLE != NEUTRAL. UNAVAILABLE != 0. UNAVAILABLE != average. UNAVAILABLE != bad quality. Never imputed silently, in either direction (never upgraded to a value, never downgraded to a worse state).

causality.invariant: SQ(t0) must remain immutable with respect to future market observations, where t0 = limit_created_bar.
causality.verification_method: shadow-replay parity (0 discrepancies) + causal re-slice per source contract; cross-checked again in BOT-051.1 and BOT-024.4 via successful trade_id joins with 0 loss

reconstructibility_evidence.base_universe_note: Bounded by Alignment's own pre-computed artifact (Universe B, filled+closed trades) -- an ARTIFACT scope limitation, not a contract limitation. Momentum/Structure/Context are all causally computable for the full Universe A (3207 LIMITs); Alignment's consensus simply was never pre-computed for the 733 non-filled LIMITs in the existing artifacts.
reconstructibility_evidence.unavailable_source: 100% from Alignment (18/18); Momentum/Structure/Context show 0 UNAVAILABLE within this base universe (their own tiny warm-up edge cases happen to fall in the non-filled 733, outside Universe B)
reconstructibility_evidence.join_success: 2474/2474 for momentum, structure and context (0 discrepancies, 0 duplicates)

momentum_vs_structure.value: rho=+0.317 (roc_atr_3 vs origin_dist_atr, per BOT-024.4 section 4, recomputed against the actual canonical Momentum feature)
momentum_vs_structure.resolved_discrepancy: BOT-048.2 had earlier reported rho=-0.214 for 'Momentum' vs origin_dist_atr, but that figure was computed against momentum_roc_atr_10 (a 10-bar candidate that was NEVER promoted to canonical). BOT-024.4 recomputed the correlation against the actual canonical roc_atr_3 and obtained rho=+0.317. Different sign and magnitude because they are different features, not a contradiction of the same measurement.

momentum_vs_context.note: BOT-050.2's joint diagnostic model used roc_atr_3 as a control variable BEFORE it was formally canonical (BOT-024.4 postdates BOT-050.2). Now that roc_atr_3 IS the canonical Momentum feature, this retroactively CONFIRMS (rather than weakens) that Context's TEMPORAL_ONLY_FREEZE ownership test rested on the correct feature, not a placeholder -- resolves the methodological caveat flagged as Risk #4 in BOT-051.1.
momentum_vs_context.value: no strong pattern -- weekday-conditional means of roc_atr_3 range 0.93-1.02, per BOT-024.4 section 4

momentum_vs_alignment.value: descriptive only (Alignment is categorical/non-ordinal by design) -- roc_atr_3 means by Alignment Consensus state range 0.93-1.00, no marked pattern, per BOT-024.4 section 4

structure_vs_context.note: frozen contracts (origin_dist_atr vs weekday) unrelated; the REJECTED Context candidate atr_ratio_short_long did overlap with Structure's HTF mechanism, already resolved before this task by demoting it to CROSS_FACTOR_ONLY

quality_semantics.definition: Signal Quality v1 is a causal, multidimensional description of the observable setup at the moment a LIMIT is born. It is not a guaranteed prediction of outcome, nor a retrospective judgment of whether the trade won or lost.
quality_semantics.rule: Outcome (pnl_r, pnl_usd, outcome, fill/no-fill, MFE/MAE) must never be used to define, redefine, or retrospectively adjust any component of the vector.

why_not_scalar_yet: Two of the four factors (Momentum, Structure) are RAW continuous by their own frozen contracts -- no defensible bins exist yet.
Alignment is categorical and explicitly non-ordinal by its own frozen contract.
No defensible weights exist across four heterogeneous factors -- assigning any would be arbitrary.
None of the four factors is OOS-validated yet (BOT-024.3/BOT-047.3/BOT-048.3/BOT-050.3 all BLOCKED/WAITING).
Collapsing to a scalar before OOS risks retrofitting a score to historical outcome, which the project's experimental rule explicitly forbids.
This does NOT mean a 0-100 score is impossible -- it means it is not defined yet. The frozen vector is the architectural base a future, evidence-justified reduction would build on.
invariants: 1. observed_at_bar == limit_created_bar for every factor, verified identical across all four.
2. No future leakage -- no field may depend on fill_bar, outcome, or any bar after limit_created_bar.
3. The vector is immutable after creation -- no field is recomputed or reinterpreted once observed.
4. Exactly four quality dimensions: Momentum, Alignment, Structure, Context.
5. Economics is not a field of the schema -- absent, not null, not UNAVAILABLE.
6. direction is required metadata, never a quality factor, never scored.
7. UNAVAILABLE is never imputed silently, in either direction.
8. RAW continuous contracts (Momentum, Structure) remain RAW -- no bins, no thresholds invented.
10. Context remains categorical (full weekday enum) per its own frozen contract.
11. No outcome (pnl_r/pnl_usd/outcome/MFE/MAE/fill) forms part of the contract.
12. No weight forms part of v1.
13. No quality threshold forms part of v1.
14. No execution gate forms part of v1.
15. Alignment's NEUTRAL is a real observed value, never conflated with UNAVAILABLE.
16. The vector's fully-reconstructible universe today is bounded by Alignment's own artifact scope (Universe B, N=2474) -- documented explicitly, not silently narrowed or hidden.
17. Any reopening of an excluded/frozen source contract (Economics, or any of the four factors) uses a new ticket ID, never a silent reinterpretation of this contract.
